record.title: Evaluate the renewed lease and RF execution window
record.intent: Release the existing stock rollback only on verified timing and lease prerequisites.
requirements: Review independent controls and sealed REQUEST/ACK against renewed authority. The wider window changes only timing; no numerical protocol, specimen wiring, options or calibration amendment is implied.
On supported go release the existing rollback and comparison gates. On failure retain a hold and record the exact bounded remedy. Commit/push before any native transition.
acceptance: A supported go or hold resolves the renewed window without claiming an RF result.
